environment: local synthetic unit fixtures; no provider requests, customer calls or production writes
controls: Validated latest ASR revision supplies canonical text; original text remains audit evidence.
Owned empty first final can be corrected without pointing a contact source at a missing row.
Malformed, mismatched, retracted or truncated revision cannot resurrect original facts.
Legacy speaker/text and wrapped turns survive canonical summary/API rendering.
Exact accepted raw object gets traditional source identity; identical different turns survive; exact duplicate event collapses.
Actual TranscriptHandler/TurnEnder/TurnRunner associates separate value and confirmation source hashes.
Successful clarification submission is recorded/flushed; failed/interrupted submission is not presented as completed speech.
Owned tenant/call row lock serializes final writes; call and child snapshot share transaction; zero-row is not success.
Failed/cancelled finalization keeps bounded frozen memory; only acknowledged final save clears it.
Summary qualification and status writes use full raw transcript/action snapshot fences.
Calls-list candidate projection rejects stale confirmation and value evidence before display selection.
Finalizer retries idempotent contact capture after transcript commit; independent failure note is not transcript success.

migration.rollback: Column/evidence retained on downgrade; IF NOT EXISTS supports re-upgrade.

limitations: No provider, PSTN, human transcription accuracy or end-user pilot qualification was performed.
Finalization retains only process memory: up to64 failed calls,300seconds,2000000 aggregate content/metadata characters; eviction is opportunistic, not durable recovery.
Process death or exhausted/expired memory can lose never-persisted final evidence; saved partial/unknown state is not relabeled complete.
Transcript complete certifies only its transaction snapshot, not all contact writes, audio delivery or caller hearing.
If the database also rejects contact retries and the failure notice, no durable automatic contact recovery is claimed; review canonical saved transcript manually.
Traditional capture does not fabricate a readback receipt ID: readback remains null where that path retains none.
Legacy unversioned contacts retain their historical claim as unversioned; missing source proof is not invented.
Calls-list projection considers at most64 contact candidates per call, prioritizing primary fields and manual entries before projection.
